test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following question, set of letter clusters are given. The letter clusters of each set are related to the letter clusters of the same set by some Logic/Rule/Relation. From the given alternatives, select a group of letter clusters which follows the same Logic/Rule/Relation.

 (FE, HG, LL) 

 (IK, KM, OR)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8ef800a3f2b2c106d71244e30cc0d8fb80e6e253d4f42a34e810a88ac0f7965.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, FE → HG → LL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e871b1db9e31375f06493fd8aefc9405e5a2c21755c9bd5f1ef87e3a57c160a.png] 

For, IK → KM → OR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b4ce22a11d61b2af159ff813482c548b96abde2935d8e6225002d4d2393b1e0.png] 

Now check the options:

For, EU → GW → KB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7625641d77d744d98811b6b5aa5369e477410d7a61cee40c57d39b18df2aa335.png] 

So, EU → GW → KB follows the same pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
